--- migrate.sql ---
-- Migration: add and backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping sourced from codes.csv.
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');

COMMIT;
--- effects log ---
apply migration to staging
